query:
SELECT
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT
                        1
                    FROM
                        email_links l
                    WHERE
                        l.id = $1
                        AND NOT l.is_sync_active
                        AND l.disconnect_requested_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND NOT EXISTS (
                            SELECT
                                1
                            FROM
                                email_mailbox_lifecycle_outbox o
                            WHERE
                                o.link_id = l.id
                                AND o.payload ->> 'kind' IN ('cleanup_microsoft_watches', 'revoke_microsoft_grant', 'disconnect_imap'))) AS "ready!"
